facilities.name: Al Udeid Air Base / Combined Air Operations Center

damage_events.note: Air & Space Forces reports multiple Iranian missiles hit the CAOC in the early weeks; Bellingcat imagery comparison Feb. 22-Mar. 14 shows damage at Al Udeid. Exact CAOC strike date unresolved.

verified_physical_damage: Multiple missile strikes severely damaged the Combined Air Operations Center; satellite imagery shows additional visible building damage at the base.
degradation_evidence: Loss of a major forward regional air-operations C2 node.
continued_operation_evidence: Air & Space Forces: CAOC was not in use at the time and attacks did not interfere with Operation Epic Fury or later limited strikes.
Campaign directed from Shaw AFB from the start.
Pre-war Air Force records demonstrate deliberate distributed CAOC operation between Al Udeid and Shaw.
facilities.assessment: Verified CAOC knockout is not evidence that the entire base stopped operating. Whole-base functional status requires separate runway/logistics/comms/air-defense continuity data.
what_would_change_assessment: Independent evidence that runway/air operations/logistics/base-wide communications ceased for a defined period.
Dated evidence that the CAOC returned to service or was reconstituted elsewhere on the installation.

revision_history.change: Integrated from historical backfill and reconciled against current atlas.

Preserve current atlas facility identity US-ALUDEID. Enrich with pre-war distributed-C2 context. Do not assign the CAOC disabling effect to a specific March strike date until the exact chronology is verified.

facilities.name: Barakah Nuclear Power Plant

damage_events.note: CRS reports one of three Iranian drones hit an electrical generator outside the plant’s inner perimeter.

verified_physical_damage: Electrical generator outside inner perimeter hit.
verified_functional_effect: One reactor automatically shut down according to the CRS synthesis.
degradation_evidence: Electrical support-system damage and reactor shutdown.
continued_operation_evidence: No cited evidence of radiological release or destruction of the entire multi-unit facility.
facilities.assessment: UNSC later condemned the attack without independently attributing responsibility. Current reactor/repaired-generator status remains a gap in this package.
what_would_change_assessment: Operator/regulator evidence establishing reactor restart date, prolonged outage, or additional plant damage.

revision_history.change: Integrated from historical backfill and reconciled against current atlas.

facilities.name: Kuwait International Airport

damage_events.note: Iranian drone/missile attack reported by Reuters from state/regional sources.

verified_functional_effect: Flight disruption and terminal degradation; one fatality reported.
continued_operation_evidence: Terminal 4 flights resumed/continued, affirmative evidence against total airport shutdown.
facilities.assessment: Damage did not equal complete loss of airport function.
what_would_change_assessment: Airport authority operating logs establishing broader outage duration or later repair completion.

revision_history.change: Integrated from historical backfill and reconciled against current atlas.

verified_functional_effect: IAEA said facility was no longer operational.
facilities.assessment: No declared nuclear material was reported at the site in the cited account. Repair/reconstitution status unresolved.
what_would_change_assessment: IAEA or independently verified imagery showing repair/restart.

facilities.name: Qatar LNG export infrastructure (system-level record)

damage_events.note: Reuters March 20 reporting describes damage following regional energy-site escalation.

verified_physical_damage: Damage to Qatar LNG export infrastructure sufficient to reduce export capacity materially.
verified_functional_effect: QatarEnergy CEO said roughly one-sixth of export capacity affected; repair estimate cited as 3-5 years for damaged capacity.
continued_operation_evidence: The report describes partial capacity loss, not total Qatar LNG-system shutdown.
facilities.assessment: System-level record avoids inventing exact sub-facility attribution beyond the cited reporting.
what_would_change_assessment: Dated subfacility-level repair/restart data and exact affected export-train identification.

revision_history.change: Integrated from historical backfill and reconciled against current atlas.
